members.name: G0A.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: first letter upper case, rest lower case

members.name: G0B.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: upper-case the first letter of a String

members.name: G0C.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'LC' BIND LC 0 GET UPPER LC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Word to its first letter upper-cased and the rest lower-cased.

members.name: G0D.CAP
members.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER W CHARS 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: A word with its first letter upper-cased and the rest lower-cased.

members.name: L1A.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'CW' BIND CW 0 GET UPPER CW 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: non-empty word with first letter upper, rest lower

members.name: L1B.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: non-empty word to first letter upper, rest lower

members.name: L1C.UP1
members.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Upper-case the first letter of a String, leave the rest as it is.

members.name: L1C.CAP
members.body: LOWER L1C.UP1
members.note: Title-case one word: lower-case it, then upper-case its first letter.

members.name: L1D.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: one word -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case

members.name: L2A.CAP
members.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: non-empty String -> first character upper case, the rest lower case

members.name: L2B.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'ZC' BIND ZC 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT ZC 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
members.note: A word to first letter upper case, rest lower case.

members.name: L2C.CAP
members.body: 'ZW' BIND ZW CHARS 0 GET UPPER ZW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Upper-cases the first character of a text and leaves the rest unchanged.

members.name: L2D.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'CS' BIND CS 0 CS 0 GET UPPER PUT JOIN
members.note: Non-empty String -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case.

members.name: L3A.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'KC' BIND KC 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER KC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case

members.name: L3B.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Word to first letter upper case, rest lower case.

members.name: L3C.CAP
members.body: 'CW' BIND CW CHARS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Non-empty word -> first letter upper case, the rest kept as they are.

members.name: L3D.CAP
members.body: LOWER CHARS 'XC' BIND XC 0 GET UPPER XC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
members.note: Non-empty word -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case.

members.name: G0A.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'ML' BIND MS ML 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS ML 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers

members.name: G0B.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: median of a Vector of numbers

members.name: G0C.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'LS' BIND LS LENGTH 'LN' BIND LS LN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR LN 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0C.SUM 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

members.name: G0D.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle values when even).

members.name: L1A.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'QT' BIND QT LENGTH 'QN' BIND QT QN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET QT QN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector

members.name: L1B.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'MDV' BIND MDV LENGTH 'MLN' BIND MDV MLN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MDV MLN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers

members.name: L1C.MED
members.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a non-empty Vector of exact numbers (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

members.name: L1D.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'SS' BIND SS LENGTH 'SN' BIND SS SN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SS SN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

members.name: L2A.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'ML' BIND MS ML 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS ML 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> median (mean of the two middle values when even)

members.name: L2B.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'ZS' BIND ZS LENGTH 'ZL' BIND ZS ZL 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET ZS ZL 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector.

members.name: L2C.MED
members.body: 'ZV' BIND ZV SORT 'ZS' BIND ZV LENGTH 'ZN' BIND ZS ZN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET ZS ZN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle values when even).

members.name: L2D.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'SV' BIND SV LENGTH 'LN' BIND SV LN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SV LN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

members.name: L3A.MEDIAN
members.body: 'MS' BIND MS SORT 'MZ' BIND MZ MS LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MZ MS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> median

members.name: L3B.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector.

members.name: L3C.MED
members.body: 'MX' BIND MX SORT 'MS' BIND MS MX LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR MX LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET L2B.MEAN
members.note: Non-empty numeric Vector -> median (mean of the two middle values when even).

members.name: L3D.MEDIAN
members.body: SORT 'XS' BIND XS LENGTH 'XN' BIND XS XN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET XS XN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
members.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

members.name: G0A.UNWORDS
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN -1 DROP JOIN
members.note: join a non-empty Vector of Strings with single spaces

members.name: G0B.SPACED
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces

members.name: G0C.SPJOIN
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Vector of texts joined by single spaces, no leading or trailing space.

members.name: L1A.JOINSP
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: join a Vector of space-free Strings with single spaces ('' for empty)

members.name: L1B.SJOIN
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces

members.name: L1C.SPJOIN
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Join a Vector of Strings with single spaces, no space at either end.

members.name: L1D.UNWORDS
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Vector of words -> one String joined by single spaces

members.name: L2B.JOINSP
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN JOIN TRIM
members.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces.

members.name: L2C.JOINSP
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Joins a Vector of texts with single spaces.

members.name: L2D.SPJOIN
members.body: '' [ 'W' BIND ' ' W 3 COLLECT JOIN ] FOLD TRIM
members.note: Vector of words -> one String joined by single spaces, no space at either end.

members.name: L3A.UNWORDS
members.body: [ 'UW' BIND ' ' UW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Vector of space-free words -> one String joined by single spaces

members.name: L3B.SPJOIN
members.body: [ 1 COLLECT ' ' 1 COLLECT CONCAT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces.

members.name: L3C.SJ
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS -1 DROP JOIN
members.note: Non-empty Vector of texts -> one text with single spaces between them.

members.name: L3D.UNWORDS
members.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
members.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces ('' for an empty Vector).

members.name: G0A.ABS
members.body: 'AV' BIND AV AV -1 MUL MAX
members.note: absolute value, lifts over Vectors

members.name: G0B.ABS
members.body: 'AD' BIND AD AD -1 MUL MAX
members.note: absolute value of a scalar or element-wise of a Vector

members.name: G0C.ABS
members.body: 'LD' BIND LD 0 LD SUB MAX
members.note: Absolute value of an exact number.

members.name: G0D.ABS
members.body: 'X' BIND X -1 MUL X X 0 LT SELECT
members.note: Absolute value of a scalar, or lane by lane over a Vector.

members.name: L1A.ABS
members.body: 'AB' BIND AB AB -1 MUL MAX
members.note: absolute value, lifts over Vectors

members.name: L1D.ABS
members.body: 'AX' BIND AX AX -1 MUL MAX
members.note: absolute value of a number, lifts over Vectors

members.name: L2A.ABS
members.body: 'AB' BIND AB AB -1 MUL MAX
members.note: number or numeric Vector -> absolute value, lane by lane

members.name: L2B.ABS
members.body: 'ZA' BIND ZA ZA -1 MUL MAX
members.note: Absolute value of a number or Vector (lane-wise).

members.name: L2D.ABS
members.body: 'AV' BIND AV -1 MUL AV MAX
members.note: Absolute value of a number or of each element of a Vector.

members.name: L3A.ABS
members.body: 'AB' BIND AB AB -1 MUL MAX
members.note: absolute value; lifts over a Vector

members.name: L3C.ABS
members.body: 'AB' BIND AB 0 AB SUB MAX
members.note: Number or Vector -> absolute value, as max of x and minus x.

members.name: L3D.ABS
members.body: 'XA' BIND XA XA -1 MUL MAX
members.note: Absolute value of a number, lifting over a Vector lane by lane.

members.name: G0B.BYNAME
members.body: 'BL' BIND BL G0B.FIRSTS BL G0B.SECONDS G0B.GROUPSUM
members.note: Vector of [key amount] rows -> Record key -> summed amount

members.name: G0C.BYNAME
members.body: 'LV' BIND LV [ 0 GET ] MAP LV [ 1 GET ] MAP G0C.GROUPSUM
members.note: Entries [name amount] to a Record from each name to its total amount.

members.name: G0D.LEDGER-SUMS
members.body: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP G0D.SUMS-BY
members.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries to a Record name -> summed amount.

members.name: L1B.NAMESUMS
members.body: 'EN' BIND EN [ 0 GET ] MAP EN [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'GR' BIND GR KEYS GR VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Vector of [name amount] to Record name -> sum, first-appearance order

members.name: L1C.BYNAME
members.body: 'ENTS' BIND ENTS [ 0 GET ] MAP ENTS [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Ledger entries to a Record from each name to the sum of its amounts, names in first-appearance order.

members.name: L2A.BYNAME
members.body: 'LBV' BIND LBV [ 0 GET ] MAP LBV [ 1 GET ] MAP L2A.SUMBY
members.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record from name to summed amount, first-appearance order

members.name: L2B.LEDGER
members.body: 'ZE' BIND ZE [ 0 GET ] MAP ZE [ 1 GET ] MAP L2B.GSUM
members.note: Vector of [name amount] entries to a Record name -> sum of amounts.

members.name: L2C.BYNAME
members.body: 'ZL' BIND ZL [ 0 GET ] MAP ZL [ 1 GET ] MAP L2C.SUMBY
members.note: Ledger entries to a Record from each name to the sum of its amounts.

members.name: L3A.BYNAME
members.body: 'LE' BIND LE [ 0 GET ] MAP LE [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs -> Record key to summed amount, first-appearance order

members.name: L3C.BYNAME
members.body: 'BN' BIND BN [ 0 GET ] MAP BN [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'BG' BIND BG KEYS BG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries -> Record from name to summed amount, names in first-appearance order.

members.name: L1A.TOPKEY
members.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES L1A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: key of a Record whose (numeric) value is largest, first key on ties

members.name: G0A.TOPKEY
members.body: 'TK' BIND TK KEYS TK VALUES G0A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: key of a Record whose numeric value is largest, first on ties

members.name: G0B.TOPKEY
members.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES G0B.ARGMAX GET
members.note: Record of key->number: the key with the largest value, first on ties

members.name: G0D.TOP-KEY
members.body: 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES G0D.ARGMAX GET
members.note: Key of a Record whose numeric value is largest; the first key on ties.

members.name: L1D.TOPKEY
members.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES L1D.ARGMAX GET
members.note: Record with numeric values -> the key with the largest value, the earliest key when tied

members.name: L3A.ARGMAXKEY
members.body: 'AK' BIND AK KEYS AK VALUES L3A.ARGMAX GET
members.note: Record of numbers -> key holding the largest value, first on ties

members.name: L3B.TOPKEY
members.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES 'TV' BIND TV TV G0C.MAXV LT NOT L1D.WHERE 0 GET GET
members.note: Record of key -> number to the first key holding the largest value.

members.name: L3C.ARGMAX
members.body: 'AR' BIND AR KEYS 'AK' BIND AR VALUES 'AS' BIND AS G0C.MAXV 'AM' BIND AK AS [ AM EQ ] MAP L1D.WHERE 0 GET GET
members.note: Record of numbers -> the key with the largest value, the first such key on ties.

members.name: L3D.TOPKEY
members.body: 'XR' BIND XR KEYS XR VALUES L3D.ARGMAX GET
members.note: Record with numeric values -> the key holding the largest value, the first such key on a tie.

members.name: G0C.ORDERS
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
members.note: JSON text to the Vector of its order Records.

members.name: L2A.ORDERS
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
members.note: JSON String with an orders array -> Vector of order Records

members.name: G0A.REVENUE
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ 'RO' BIND RO 'price' GET 'RP' BIND 0 RP RP NIL? SELECT RO 'qty' GET MUL ] MAP G0A.SUM
members.note: orders JSON text -> total qty*price over priced orders

members.name: G0A.QTYBY
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'QO' BIND QO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP QO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
members.note: orders JSON text -> Record sku to total qty

members.name: G0B.REVENUE
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET [ G0B.ORDVAL ] MAP G0B.SUM
members.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over priced orders

members.name: G0B.QTYBYSKU
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET 'OL' BIND OL [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OL [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0B.GROUPSUM
members.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty

members.name: G0C.REVENUE
members.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ G0C.LINE ] MAP G0C.SUM
members.note: Total of qty times price over the priced orders, from the JSON text.

members.name: G0C.SKUQTY
members.body: G0C.ORDERS 'LO' BIND LO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP LO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP G0C.GROUPSUM
members.note: From the JSON text, a Record from each sku to its total qty.

members.name: G0C.TAGCOUNTS
members.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
members.note: From the JSON text, a Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it.

members.name: G0D.ORDERS
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
members.note: The orders array of a JSON order document, as a Vector of Records.

members.name: G0D.REVENUE
members.body: G0D.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Sum of qty*price over the priced orders of a JSON order document.

members.name: L2A.REVENUE
members.body: L2A.ORDERS [ 'price' GET NIL? NOT ] FILTER [ 'OQ' BIND OQ 'qty' GET OQ 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over orders that have a price

members.name: L2A.QTYBYSKU
members.body: L2A.ORDERS 'OO' BIND OO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP L2A.SUMBY
members.note: orders JSON String -> Record from sku to summed qty, first-appearance order

members.name: L2A.TAGCOUNTS
members.body: L2A.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP [ ] [ CONCAT ] FOLD TALLY
members.note: orders JSON String -> Record from tag to number of orders carrying it

members.name: L2B.ORDERS
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
members.note: JSON String to the Vector of order Records.

members.name: L2B.REVENUE
members.body: L2B.ORDERS [ L2B.LINE ] MAP L2B.SUM
members.note: JSON orders String to total revenue.

members.name: L2C.ORDERS
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
members.note: JSON text with an orders key to the Vector of order Records.

members.name: L2D.ORDERS
members.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
members.note: JSON String with an "orders" array -> Vector of the order Records.

members.name: G0A.MEAN
members.body: 'MV' BIND MV G0A.SUM MV LENGTH DIV
members.note: arithmetic mean of a Vector

members.name: L2B.MEAN
members.body: 'ZV' BIND ZV L2B.SUM ZV LENGTH DIV
members.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty numeric Vector, a bare scalar.

members.name: G0B.MEAN
members.body: 'MV' BIND MV G0B.SUM MV LENGTH DIV
members.note: arithmetic mean of a Vector

members.name: G0C.MEAN
members.body: 'LV' BIND LV G0C.SUM LV LENGTH DIV
members.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty numeric Vector.

members.name: G0D.MEAN
members.body: 'V' BIND V G0D.SUM V LENGTH DIV
members.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty Vector of numbers.

members.name: L2A.MEAN
members.body: 'AV' BIND AV 0 [ ADD ] FOLD AV LENGTH DIV
members.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> arithmetic mean

members.name: L2C.MEAN
members.body: 'ZV' BIND ZV L2C.SUM ZV LENGTH DIV
members.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty Vector of numbers.

members.name: L2D.MEAN
members.body: 'MV' BIND MV 0 [ ADD ] FOLD MV LENGTH DIV
members.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty numeric Vector.

members.name: G0A.SUMBY
members.body: GROUP 'GR' BIND GR KEYS GR VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: keys values -> Record key to sum of its values, first-appearance order

members.name: G0B.GROUPSUM
members.body: GROUP 'GG' BIND GG KEYS GG VALUES [ G0B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: keys-vector values-vector -> Record key -> sum of its values, first-appearance order

members.name: G0C.GROUPSUM
members.body: GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ G0C.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Keys Vector and values Vector to a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order.

members.name: G0D.SUMS-BY
members.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
members.note: keys values G0D.SUMS-BY leaves a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order.

members.name: L2A.SUMBY
members.body: 'SBV' BIND 'SBK' BIND SBK SBV GROUP 'SBG' BIND SBG KEYS SBG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
members.note: keys Vector, numbers Vector -> Record from each key to the sum of its numbers, keys in first-appearance order

members.name: L2B.GSUM
members.body: GROUP 'ZG' BIND ZG KEYS ZG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: keys-Vector values-Vector to a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order.

members.name: L2C.SUMBY
members.body: GROUP 'ZR' BIND ZR KEYS ZR VALUES [ L2C.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Keys Vector and values Vector to a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order.

members.name: L2D.SUMBY
members.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ L2D.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: keys Vector, values Vector -> Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in order of first appearance.

members.name: G0A.VAR
members.body: G0A.DEVS 'VD' BIND VD VD MUL G0A.MEAN
members.note: population variance

members.name: G0B.VAR
members.body: G0B.DEV 'DD' BIND DD DD MUL G0B.MEAN
members.note: population variance

members.name: G0C.VAR
members.body: 'LV' BIND LV G0C.MEAN 'LM' BIND LV [ LM SUB G0C.SQ ] MAP G0C.MEAN
members.note: Population variance of a numeric Vector.

members.name: G0D.VARIANCE
members.body: 'V' BIND V V G0D.MEAN SUB 'D' BIND D D MUL G0D.MEAN
members.note: Population variance of a Vector of numbers.

members.name: L2A.VAR
members.body: 'VV' BIND VV VV L2A.MEAN SUB 'VD' BIND VD VD MUL L2A.MEAN
members.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> population variance

members.name: L2B.VAR
members.body: L2B.DEV 'ZD' BIND ZD ZD MUL L2B.MEAN
members.note: Population variance of a numeric Vector.

members.name: L2C.VAR
members.body: 'ZS' BIND ZS L2C.MEAN 'ZM' BIND ZS ZM SUB 'ZD' BIND ZD ZD MUL L2C.MEAN
members.note: Population variance of a non-empty Vector of numbers.

members.name: L2D.VAR
members.body: 'VX' BIND VX VX L2D.MEAN SUB 'VD' BIND VD VD MUL L2D.MEAN
members.note: Population variance of a numeric Vector (mean of squared deviations).

members.name: G0A.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for empty)

members.name: L2B.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Vector of numbers to its sum (0 for empty).

members.name: G0B.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 when empty)

members.name: G0C.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Sum of a numeric Vector; 0 for an empty one.

members.name: G0D.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for an empty Vector).

members.name: L2C.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for an empty Vector).

members.name: L2D.SUM
members.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Sum of a numeric Vector (0 for an empty one).

members.name: L1A.ARGMAX
members.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
members.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, first on ties

members.name: G0A.ARGMAX
members.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
members.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, first on ties

members.name: G0B.ARGMAX
members.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
members.note: index of the first largest element of a Vector of numbers

members.name: G0D.ARGMAX
members.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
members.note: Index of the largest number in a Vector; the first one on ties.

members.name: L1D.ARGMAX
members.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
members.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, the first one when tied

members.name: L3A.ARGMAX
members.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
members.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> index of its largest element, first on ties

members.name: L3D.ARGMAX
members.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
members.note: Index of the first largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector (ties go to the earliest).

members.name: G0A.MOD
members.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
members.note: a b -> a mod b (floored), lifts over Vectors

members.name: L2A.MOD
members.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
members.note: a b -> a - b * floor(a/b); lifts over a Vector in either operand

members.name: G0B.MOD
members.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
members.note: a b -> a mod b (floor remainder)

members.name: G0C.MOD
members.body: 'LB' BIND 'LA' BIND LA LA LB DIV FLOOR LB MUL SUB
members.note: Remainder a mod b for a stack pair [a b] with a below b.

members.name: G0D.MOD
members.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A A B DIV FLOOR B MUL SUB
members.note: a b G0D.MOD leaves a - b*floor(a/b), the remainder.

members.name: L2D.MOD
members.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
members.note: a b -> a modulo b (a - b*floor(a/b)); lifts over Vectors in either operand.

members.name: G0A.LEDGER
members.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET G0A.SUMBY
members.note: Vector of [name amount] pairs -> Record name to total

members.name: L1A.BYNAME
members.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Vector of [key amount] pairs to Record key -> summed amount, first-appearance order

members.name: L1D.BY-NAME
members.body: 'LE' BIND LE L1D.NAMES LE L1D.AMOUNTS GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record name -> sum of its amounts, names in first-appearance order

members.name: L3B.BYNAME
members.body: ZIP 'ZZ' BIND ZZ 0 GET ZZ 1 GET GROUP 'GG' BIND GG KEYS GG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Vector of [name amount] entries to Record name -> sum of amounts, first-appearance order.

members.name: L3D.SUMS
members.body: ZIP 'XT' BIND XT 0 GET XT 1 GET GROUP 'XG' BIND XG KEYS XG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
members.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record name -> sum of its amounts, names in order of first appearance.

members.name: L1A.BRVAL
members.body: CHARS [ 'BX' BIND 1 -1 BX '(' EQ NOT BX '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT ] MAP
members.note: bracket String to Vector of +1 (opener) / -1 (closer)

members.name: L1B.DELTAS
members.body: '[' '(' REPLACE ']' ')' REPLACE CHARS [ 'CH' BIND 1 -1 CH '(' EQ SELECT ] MAP
members.note: bracket String to Vector of +1 (opener) / -1 (closer)

members.name: L1D.BSIGNS
members.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
members.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opening bracket and -1 per closing bracket

members.name: L3A.STEPS
members.body: '[' '(' REPLACE ']' ')' REPLACE CHARS [ 'BC' BIND 1 -1 BC '(' EQ SELECT ] MAP
members.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opening and -1 per closing bracket

members.name: L3D.DELTAS
members.body: CHARS [ 'XC' BIND 1 -1 '([' XC SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
members.note: Bracket String -> Vector of +1 for each opener ( [ and -1 for each closer ) ].

members.name: L1B.REDUCE
members.body: 'RS' BIND 1 6 RANGE RS [ 'IGN' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
members.note: delete adjacent () and [] pairs six times; leaves the reduced String

members.name: L1D.BREDUCE
members.note: bracket String (up to 12 chars) with every adjacent matched pair () or [] repeatedly deleted

members.name: L3A.RED1
members.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
members.note: one round of deleting adjacent matched pairs () and []

members.name: L3A.REDUCE
members.body: L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1
members.note: bracket String (<=12 chars) -> what remains after deleting matched pairs until none is left

members.name: L3B.RED1
members.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
members.note: String of brackets with every adjacent () and [] pair deleted once.

members.name: L3B.RED6
members.body: L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1 L3B.RED1
members.note: Bracket String fully reduced by deleting matched pairs (enough rounds for up to 12 characters).

members.name: L3D.RED1
members.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
members.note: One round of deleting every adjacent '()' and '[]' pair from a bracket String.

members.name: L3D.REDUCE
members.body: L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1 L3D.RED1
members.note: Bracket String of at most 12 characters with every adjacent matched pair deleted repeatedly (6 rounds); '' when balanced.

members.name: G0A.WORDS
members.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
members.note: split a String on spaces, dropping empty pieces

members.name: G0B.WORDS
members.body: LOWER ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH 0 GT ] FILTER
members.note: String -> lower-case words split on spaces, empty pieces dropped

members.name: G0C.WORDS
members.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
members.note: Text to the Vector of its non-empty space-separated words.

members.name: G0D.WORDS
members.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
members.note: Split a String on spaces into its non-empty words (any spacing, leading/trailing spaces allowed).

members.name: G0C.MAD
members.body: 'LV' BIND LV G0C.MEDIAN 'LM' BIND LV [ LM SUB G0C.ABS ] MAP G0C.MEDIAN
members.note: Median absolute deviation of a numeric Vector.

members.name: L1A.MAD
members.body: 'QV' BIND QV QV L1A.MEDIAN SUB L1A.ABS L1A.MEDIAN
members.note: median absolute deviation of a numeric Vector

members.name: L2A.MAD
members.body: 'MV' BIND MV MV L2A.MEDIAN SUB L2A.ABS L2A.MEDIAN
members.note: numeric Vector -> median absolute deviation from the median

members.name: L3A.MAD
members.body: 'DV' BIND DV DV L3A.MEDIAN SUB L3A.ABS L3A.MEDIAN
members.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> median absolute deviation from the median

members.name: G0D.DIVISORS
members.body: 'K' BIND 1 K RANGE [ 'D' BIND K K D DIV FLOOR D MUL SUB 0 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: Ascending Vector of the positive divisors of a positive integer.

members.name: L2A.DIVISORS
members.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DN DD L2A.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

members.name: L2C.DIVS
members.body: 'ZN' BIND 1 ZN RANGE [ 'ZD' BIND ZN ZD DIV FLOOR ZD MUL ZN EQ ] FILTER
members.note: Ascending positive divisors of a positive integer N.

members.name: L2D.DIVISORS
members.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'D' BIND DN D L2D.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
members.note: Positive integer -> Vector of its positive divisors, ascending.

members.name: G0A.DEVS
members.body: 'DV' BIND DV DV G0A.MEAN SUB
members.note: each number minus the mean

members.name: G0B.DEV
members.body: 'DV' BIND DV DV G0B.MEAN SUB
members.note: each number minus the mean

members.name: L2B.DEV
members.body: 'ZW' BIND ZW ZW L2B.MEAN SUB
members.note: Vector of each number minus the mean.

members.name: G0B.ORDVAL
members.body: 'OO' BIND OO 'price' GET 'OP' BIND 0 OP OP NIL? SELECT OO 'qty' GET MUL
members.note: order Record -> qty times price, 0 when it has no price

members.name: G0C.LINE
members.body: 'LR' BIND LR 'qty' GET LR 'price' GET MUL
members.note: qty times price of one order Record.

members.name: L2B.LINE
members.body: 'ZO' BIND ZO 'qty' GET ZO L2B.PRICE MUL
members.note: Order Record to qty times price (0 when unpriced).

members.name: L1A.BALPREFIX
members.body: CHARS [ '#' ] [ L1A.BRSTEP ] SCAN 'BP' BIND BP [ LENGTH 0 MUL 1 ADD ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN [ 'BI' BIND BI 0 BP BI 1 SUB GET LENGTH 1 EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String

members.name: L1B.BPREFIX
members.body: CHARS 'CV' BIND 0 CV LENGTH RANGE [ 'KK' BIND KK 0 CV KK TAKE JOIN L1B.BALANCED SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: length of longest balanced prefix of a bracket String

members.name: L3A.BPREFIX
members.body: CHARS 'PC' BIND 0 PC LENGTH RANGE [ 'PK' BIND PC PK TAKE JOIN L3A.REDUCE '' EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix

members.name: L1A.PRESENT
members.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
members.note: drop NIL elements of a Vector

members.name: L1A.FFILL
members.body: 'FV' BIND FV FV L1A.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'FX' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FX FX NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
members.note: forward-fill NILs; leading NILs take the first present value

members.name: L1D.PRESENT
members.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
members.note: Vector -> the same Vector without its NIL elements

members.name: L3A.PRESENT
members.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
members.note: Vector -> its non-NIL elements

members.name: L3A.FILLED
members.body: 'FV' BIND FV FV L3A.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'FX' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FX FX NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
members.note: readings with NILs -> forward-filled, leading NILs take the first present reading

members.name: L1A.GAPS
members.body: [ NIL? ] MAP FALSE 0 2 COLLECT [ L1A.GAPSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
members.note: number of runs of consecutive NILs

members.name: L1A.LONGGAP
members.body: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 0 2 COLLECT [ L1A.LGSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
members.note: length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 if none)

members.name: L3A.GAPS
members.body: L3A.MISSMASK 'GK' BIND GK 1 [ 0 ] GK CONCAT -1 DROP SUB MUL L2B.SUM
members.note: Vector with NILs -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

members.name: L3D.COUNT
members.body: [ TRUE EQ ] FILTER LENGTH
members.note: Vector of truths -> how many are TRUE.

members.name: L1B.MISS
members.body: [ NIL? ] MAP 'MF' BIND 1 0 MF SELECT
members.note: readings to 1 where missing (NIL), 0 where present

members.name: L3A.MISSMASK
members.body: [ NIL? 'GM' BIND 1 0 GM SELECT ] MAP
members.note: Vector -> 1 where the element is NIL, 0 elsewhere

members.name: L3B.MISS
members.body: [ NIL? 'MQ' BIND 1 0 MQ SELECT ] MAP
members.note: Vector with NILs to 1 where missing and 0 where present.

members.name: G0C.MAXV
members.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: Largest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

members.name: G0B.MAXOF
members.body: 'XV' BIND XV XV 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD
members.note: largest element of a non-empty Vector

members.name: L2C.REV
members.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'ORD' BIND ORD 'qty' GET ORD 'price' GET MUL ] MAP L2C.SUM
members.note: Total of qty times price over the orders that have a price.

members.name: L2C.TAGS
members.body: [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET ] MAP [ UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
members.note: Orders Vector to a Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it.

members.name: L2D.REVENUE
members.body: [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
members.note: Vector of order Records -> sum of qty*price over the orders that have a price.

members.name: G0A.SPAN
members.body: SORT 'SP' BIND SP -1 GET SP 0 GET SUB
members.note: largest minus smallest

members.name: L2A.RANGEV
members.body: SORT 'RS' BIND RS -1 GET RS 0 GET SUB
members.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> largest minus smallest

members.name: G0B.MODEOF
members.body: TALLY G0B.TOPKEY
members.note: most frequent element of a Vector, first-appearing on ties

members.name: L1B.TOPW
members.body: TALLY 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
members.note: most frequent element of a Vector; ties go to the earliest first occurrence

members.name: G0B.FIRSTS
members.body: [ 0 GET ] MAP
members.note: first element of each row of a Vector of Vectors

members.name: L2D.NAMES
members.body: [ 0 GET ] MAP
members.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> Vector of the names (first elements).

members.name: G0B.SECONDS
members.body: [ 1 GET ] MAP
members.note: second element of each row of a Vector of Vectors

members.name: L2D.AMTS
members.body: [ 1 GET ] MAP
members.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> Vector of the amounts (second elements).

members.name: G0B.CSTEP
members.body: 'CX' BIND 3 CX MUL 1 ADD CX 2 DIV CX 2 G0B.MOD 0 GT SELECT 'CY' BIND 1 CY CX 1 EQ SELECT
members.note: one Collatz step, with 1 staying at 1

members.name: L2B.CSTEP
members.body: 'ZX' BIND 1 ZX 3 MUL 1 ADD ZX 2 DIV ZX ZX 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB 0 GT SELECT ZX 1 EQ SELECT
members.note: One Collatz step; 1 stays 1.

members.name: G0C.MINV
members.body: 'LX' BIND LX LX 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
members.note: Smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

members.name: L2D.MINV
members.body: 'MNV' BIND MNV MNV 0 GET [ MIN ] FOLD
members.note: Smallest element of a non-empty numeric Vector.

members.name: G0D.FIB-INDEX
members.note: Smallest k with F(k) >= n (F(1)=F(2)=1), for n up to 987.

members.name: L2A.FIBINDEX
members.body: 'FN' BIND 30 L2A.FIBS [ FN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
members.note: positive integer n (up to F(30)) -> smallest k with F(k) >= n

members.name: L1A.RLE
members.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ L1A.RLESTEP ] FOLD
members.note: run-length encoding [ [ value count ] ... ] of a non-empty Vector

members.name: L3A.RLE
members.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RA -1 GET 'RL' BIND RA -1 DROP RX RL 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT RA RX 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RL 0 GET RX EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD
members.note: non-empty Vector -> run-length encoding as [ value count ] pairs

members.name: L1A.UPRUNS
members.body: 'UV' BIND UV UV 0 GET 0 0 3 COLLECT [ L1A.UPSTEP ] FOLD 2 GET
members.note: length of the longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch

members.name: L3A.UPRUNS
members.body: 'UV' BIND UV UV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'UX' BIND 'UA' BIND UX UA 1 GET 1 ADD 1 UX UA 0 GET GT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP G0C.MAXV
members.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> length of longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch

members.name: L1B.BALANCED
members.body: L1B.REDUCE '' EQ
members.note: bracket String to TRUE when fully balanced

members.name: L3B.BAL
members.body: L3B.RED6 '' EQ
members.note: Bracket String to TRUE when properly nested and matched.

members.name: L1B.MAJ
members.body: 'MJ' BIND MJ TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS 'MK' BIND MT VALUES 'MC' BIND MC -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET 'MI' BIND MK MI MK LENGTH MC MI GET 2 MUL MJ LENGTH GT SELECT GET
members.note: value in more than half the positions, else NIL

members.name: L3A.MAJ
members.body: 'MV' BIND MV TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS MT VALUES L3A.ARGMAX GET NIL 2 COLLECT 0 1 MT VALUES G0C.MAXV 2 MUL MV LENGTH GT SELECT GET
members.note: non-empty Vector -> value filling more than half the positions, or NIL

members.name: L2A.MOVING3
members.body: 'MVT' BIND MVT -2 DROP MVT 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MVT 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: numeric Vector (3+) -> means of every three consecutive numbers

members.name: L3A.MOVING3
members.body: 'WV' BIND WV -2 DROP WV 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD WV 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
members.note: numeric Vector of length >= 3 -> means of each three consecutive numbers
